description: This file contains unit tests for the SyncConflictResolver component, verifying conflict resolution logic for calendar events and leave records in an Android application.

classes.name: SyncConflictResolverTest
classes.description: Unit test class for verifying conflict resolution logic in SyncConflictResolver implementation.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes mock context and SyncConflictResolver instance before each test.

methods.name: mergeEvents should keep longer title and combine descriptions
methods.description: Verifies that when two CalendarEvents conflict, the resolver retains the event with the longer title and the remote description.

methods.name: mergeLeaves should preserve local type on conflict
methods.description: Checks that when two Leave objects conflict, the resolver preserves the local leave's type and description.
